unit: Comparative scriptural appendix and conclusion; apparatus separately inspected

source.title: وقفات مع شبهة ... فمن خلق الله؟
source.author: Sami Ameri
source.page_mapping: Printed number equals one-based PDF page on visually verified numbered pages. Unnumbered/blank pages use PDF ordinal only.

method.primary_reading: Read full extracted pages and footnotes as connected prose across the assigned span; no keyword selection or topical search substituted for reading.
method.acquisition_and_recovery: Initial combined skill/text output showed pp.194–198; pp.191–193 were separately recovered before proceeding. Thereafter batches199–206,207–214,215–222,223–230,231–238,239–246,247–252,253–260. Page242 was explicitly reread in full after a display truncation. Apparatus261–268 and269–276 read separately.
method.visual_review: Selected pages rendered from the same PDF with pdftoppm and opened with view_image; full-page illustrations, quote boundaries, Arabic Qur’anic glyphs, tables, printed wording and blank final leaves inspected.
method.limits: Not all pages were image-inspected. All nonblank argument pages were text-read including footnotes. Biblical, patristic, scientific, hadith and tafsir works cited by Ameri were not independently opened in this unit.
method.copyright_boundary: Raw PDF, extracted text and rendered pages remain temporary source scratch; output directory contains only original paraphrastic notes and a coverage ledger.

source_anomalies.issue: Printed negation conflicts with sustained surrounding thesis; probable print-level slip, not silently emended.
Claimed exact ratio is approximate: 4.5/13.7 is not 1/3.
Fourteen-hundred-plus-years wording occurs inside quotation attributed to Ibn Hazm; quotation fidelity unresolved.
Entry102 conflates Refuting Compromise with Genesis Account particulars.

classification: Contextual reading of Ameri; not independent doctrinal, scientific or historical verification; not a new original-source witness for Ibn Taymiyya necessity/agency.

pages.topic_paraphrase: Appendix title and intervention: Christian cosmological apologetics, relative Muslim absence, and proposed internal compatibility challenge.
pages.visual_check: Appendix title, stated intervention and printed page number.

pages.topic_paraphrase: Two tests, philosophical and scientific compatibility, plus stronger positive Islamic corroboration; original-language and authenticated-Sunna method; section map.
Remaining section map; praise for Craig as advocate; two scriptural premises put to the test.
Genesis question; lexical and contextual grounds; printed negation in second counter-thesis conflicts with developed argument; beginning of Ross critique.
pages.visual_check: Actual negative wording confirmed, not OCR error.

pages.topic_paraphrase: Hebrew bara compared with Arabic bara and lexical apparatus; Arabic cognate undermines claimed biblical exclusivity.
Creation verb alone does not entail no prior material; uses and synonyms; divine subject does not settle material origin.
Craig/Copan acknowledge context and cumulative inference; Ameri criticizes their case but distinguishes it from Ross’s certainty.
Ross/Qur’an and star criticism; caveated Murdock reference; transition to textual formation and historical context of Genesis.
Defense of late compilation while saying traditional dating would not remove argument; Babylonian context and Enuma Elish opening.
Enuma Elish conflict and material ordering; Genesis 1:1–10 presented for comparison.
Comparative table on formlessness, primordial waters, tehom, pre-solar light, and division of waters; King and Gunkel citations.
Table continuation on sea-monster conflict, heavenly lights and pillars; Walton’s functional-ordering interpretation introduced.
Walton quotation conclusion; criticism of Craig/Copan reply; explicit differences and rejection of wholesale-fabrication inference.
Noah/flood and compilation reconstruction; borrowing as supplement rather than abandonment of all inherited theology; ancient eternity thesis.
Borrowing argument narrowed to material origin; Genesis 1:1 translation and Hebrew text set up.
Independent versus temporal reading of bereshit; move from pre-existing material to beginningless matter; NRSV example.
NAB, NEB, French ecumenical and Young translation examples; narrative syntax supporting temporal-clause reading.
Young, NJPS, Friedman and Albright examples; Albright’s denial of direct borrowing explicitly retained.
Critique of alleged renewed translation consensus; Coote/Ord, Sasson, alternative footnotes and medieval Jewish support.
Rashi/Ibn Ezra rationales; Masoretic pointing argument criticized; historical and Karaite-influence claims.
Septuagint argument; early church diversity claim; objection to cross-author New Testament use to determine Genesis.
Hebrews 11:3 read as invisible material rather than no material; 2 Enoch analogy; authorship objection.
2 Peter water account; Logos identity versus mode of creation; punctuation-based alternative in John via Hubler.
Hubler on doctrinal development; fallback that New Testament ex nihilo would not fix Genesis; unique-opening defense introduced.
Four replies to unique-opening defense; heading alternative; conditional grant of linguistic admissibility to both translations.
Two tables compare temporal and traditional narrative ordering; formation-from-present-material reading.
Contextual conclusion for ordering rather than absolute material origination; warning against exaggerated pagan-borrowing literature.
Diodorus via Heidel on Chaldean matter; argument from Genesis’s lack of declared disagreement; Oord alternative theology begins.
Oord quotation concludes; ancient Near Eastern cosmic-architecture diagram used as borrowing evidence.
pages.visual_check: Diagram visually inspected; content absent from extraction captured as architecture illustration.

pages.topic_paraphrase: Biblical cosmic-architecture diagram and textual references; footnote qualifies position of heavenly lights in illustration.
pages.visual_check: Second diagram and qualifying footnote visually inspected.

pages.topic_paraphrase: Attack on selective Big Bang concordism; Genesis genre treated as historical narrative; transition to creation-order conflicts.
Sarfati comparison table begins; Ameri corrects water timing and rejects first-cell common-origin/abiogenesis claim.
Comparison table ends and second table; footnote distinguishes fossil ordering from evolutionary derivation.
Cosmology and fossil-order conflicts; Davies and Henry/John Morris cited against concordance.
Summary of claimed biblical ordering errors; Genesis 2 comparison; gap plus short creation interval criticized.
Young-world chronology rationale; church/Jewish ages and genealogical table begins.
Genealogy and dated-events table continues through temple construction.
Chronological conclusion; Western faith/science conflict and responses; unbelief section begins.
Unbelief and White; restricted inerrancy and Jesuit note; symbolism section begins.
Framework interpretation and John Paul II quotation on theological purpose rather than scientific instruction.
Literal young-earth reading treated as text-faithful; Morris, Ham and Sarfati; critique of scientific concordists.
Young-earth poll and Sproul quotation; footnote limits Sproul evidence to creation-day length, not present Earth age.
Patristic and later chronological tables, mostly via Sarfati and earlier chronological collections.
Chronological table ends; day-age interpretation and its contextual objections; Faber introduced.
Ross, Schroeder and Slifkin; caveat praising Schroeder’s anti-atheist work; Barr quotation.
Hasel argument and lexical context; Ameri explicitly allows multiple yom durations but gives morning/evening decisive weight.
Gap theory history and textual objection; Miller/Soden accommodation approach introduced.
Pastoral motive for accommodation; Craig’s multiple interpretations; comparative conclusion against Christian/Jewish deployment of creation proof.
Qur’an/Sunna section; agreement against eisegesis; opening cumulative Qur’anic creation-verb case.
Cumulative lexical/contextual/Companion argument for ex nihilo; beginning of biblical-acquaintance/divergence argument.
pages.visual_check: Cumulative creation claim and consensus language.

pages.topic_paraphrase: Reynolds/Wansbrough context; proposed significance of knowledgeable divergence without scientific motive available at revelation.
No biblical cosmological errors asserted; long Saturday-creation hadith criticism, including Ibn Taymiyya attribution and claims about evil.
pages.visual_check: Ibn Taymiyya attribution, long footnote layout, evil/effects wording.

pages.topic_paraphrase: Water, primordial matter, division of waters, and day-length contrasts; long critical note on water-origin hadith reports.
Arabic and Hebrew day-length flexibility; al-Raghib, Ibn Kathir and Ibn Ashur; firmament distinction.
Stars not attached to ceiling; prehuman bloodshed interpreted as animals; transition from avoidance to correction of biblical error.
Creation-order, terrestrial water, water/life and mountains contrasts; transition to positive Big Bang concordance.
Primordial heat/explosion and smoke interpretation; cosmic-expansion subsection begins.
Expansion via early tafsir, with eschatological folding as ancillary indication; three physical chronology claims.
Common material and separation; six equal periods; initial two-period material creation distinguished from subsequent formation.
pages.visual_check: Qur’anic text, equal-period premise and initial material distinction.

pages.topic_paraphrase: Two-period heaven arrangement and final two-period Earth formation; geological age identified with final third ending at present.
Objection from Companions; Ibn Abbas report and table; Ameri admits difference concerning simultaneous heaven/Earth origin.
Defense of that difference through smoke already present and joined/separated heavens/Earth; tafsir citations.
Ameri’s three-phase creation table; quoted 13.7-billion-year cosmos and 4.5-billion-year Earth estimates.
Age-ratio table and exactness claim; attribution to Mansur Hasab al-Nabi; Sunna/young-world critique begins with Ibn Hazm.
pages.visual_check: Numerical table, exactness wording and start of Ibn Hazm quotation.

pages.topic_paraphrase: Ibn Hazm quotation on unknown age, community proportions and Hour proximity; no numerical date inferable from fingers analogy.
Quotation closes with fourteen-hundred-plus-years wording; vast-duration inference; long ten-generations hadith critique begins.
pages.visual_check: Fourteen-hundred-plus-years wording remains before closing quote.

pages.topic_paraphrase: Appendix prose closes; hadith note continues, marking some transmitter uncertainty and attributing Companion report to Israelite material.
